newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms to take stake in Indonesia steel mill.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms to take stake in Indonesia steel mill.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that it, Kanematsu Corp and Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co Ltd 5480 T would take a 30 percent stake in an Indonesian stainless steel rolling mill project.
The companies will pay $60 million for the stake in PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry's PT Maspion Stainless Steel Industry, a Sumitomo Metal spokesman said.
The company is scheduled to begin production in October at the rate of 50,000 tonnes of cold-rolled stainless steel sheet per year.

Sumitomo Metal will take a 10 percent stake in the project, Kanematsu 15 percent and Nippon Yakin five percent, the spokesman said. He said Sumitomo would be one of the firms supplying hot-rolled sheet to the mill.
